meta_description: Premier Plumbers offer expert plumbing across Nottingham and surrounding areas. Fast response, competitive rates, and quality guaranteed. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Qualified Plumbers — Fast Response Across Nottingham
hero_subhead: Leaks, boiler faults, or bathroom installs — we arrive fast, fix it right, and leave your home spotless.
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to full bathroom renovations, Premier Plumbers cover every plumbing need for homeowners and landlords throughout Nottingham.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or sudden loss of water pressure — we respond quickly across Nottingham to limit damage and restore your water supply fast.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with our thorough annual services and prompt fault diagnoses, helping you avoid costly breakdowns.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: From a single fixture swap to a complete suite installation, we fit bathrooms to a high standard with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Using proven techniques to locate hidden leaks behind walls or beneath floors, we fix the source of the problem rather than just the symptom.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: We install, repair, and power-flush central heating systems to restore warmth and efficiency, cutting down on energy bills throughout Nottinghamshire homes.

services.title: Landlord & Commercial Plumbing
services.desc: Reliable scheduled maintenance and reactive repairs for landlords and small businesses, helping you meet your legal obligations and keep tenants satisfied.

about_pullquote: We treat every home we enter with the same care as our own.
about_para_1: Premier Plumbers was founded in Nottingham with a straightforward goal: deliver honest, high-quality plumbing work at fair prices. Based in Kirkby in Ashfield, we have built our reputation street by street across Nottingham and the surrounding areas over more than a decade of trading.
about_para_2: We pride ourselves on turning up when we say we will, explaining every job in plain English, and never adding hidden charges to your bill. It is that transparency and reliability that keeps our customers coming back and recommending us to their neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called Premier Plumbers after discovering a leak under the kitchen sink on a Sunday morning. They were with me within the hour, sorted the problem quickly, and the price was very fair. Brilliant service — will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Had a new bathroom fitted and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. The team was tidy, professional, and genuinely cared about getting the finish right. Couldn't be happier with the result.
reviews.author: James R.

reviews.text: Boiler stopped working in the middle of winter and Premier Plumbers had it back up and running the same afternoon. Straightforward, honest lads who didn't try to upsell me anything I didn't need. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michelle B.
